summary: Hard dependencies Tracks 02 and 03 have archived completion receipts and the repository baseline passes 184 tests plus governance validation. Track 04 remains a later-phase dependency only; its pending NSW owner decision limits affected jurisdiction-specific cases and claims without blocking synthetic governance, contracts, deterministic baselines, or national and Queensland scenarios.

Implemented benchmark governance schema and registry, six synthetic challenge cases across text, document, audio, image and signal descriptors, five hard safety/privacy gates, deterministic network-disabled suites, hashed receipts, device proxies, compact reports, CI automation and explicit H0-H8 legacy mappings. Review fixes b954a33 and 03bd75e added exact cross-platform execution manifests, emitted citation and robustness measures, completed device observations, and rejected malformed fixtures. The regression baseline passed 5 of 5 structural cases; 190 repository tests passed at 84.79 percent coverage plus lint, types, gremlin and governance checks. Generative comparators, human agreement and operational threshold calibration remain blocked on decision 20260829-002-track05-comparator-staging; no model or publication claim is made.

Fresh review closed false-completion risks in fixture traversal and symlink escape, duplicate or malformed cases, unverified modality claims, partial hard-gate enforcement, unchecked report receipts, and the missing distracting/alternative/unknown case evidence. The regenerated deterministic regression passed 6 of 6 runnable cases; the pending NSW case remains excluded. Validation passed 194 tests at 84 percent coverage plus benchmark schema, Ruff, ty, basedpyright, gremlin and repository-governance checks. Track completion and archival remain prohibited while owner decision 20260829-002-track05-comparator-staging is pending.

Owner-approved bounded acquisition admitted immutable Apache-2.0 Qwen2.5 0.5B, 1.5B and 7B Q4_K_M GGUF comparators in an isolated local no-redistribution cache and rejected the 3B research-licence candidate without acquiring its model bytes. A synthetic-only local llama.cpp pilot ran 63 fixed-seed observations with no external inference: 0, 3 and 0 strict passes respectively; all outputs were schema-valid and deterministic by model and case, with explicit negative findings retained. Receipt 9a78e0bb746ffc4957f93a37b8cd5a59f3e22958f6086fc051a0c351d7344ed7 makes no promotion or suitability claim. Human agreement and operational thresholds remain unobserved owner-governed gates, so completion and archival are not claimed.

Owner-approved agent-panel research governance replaced the independent-human repository gate without claiming human agreement. Three blind agents independently marked all local comparators unsupported; raw agreement 0.703704 and ordinal alpha 0.575597 failed conservative non-operational thresholds without retrospective relaxation. Fresh-context review exposed and remediation closed input-hash, evidence-ID, adjudication-integrity, framework-deferral, phase-dependency, private-data and five-gate mapping gaps. The final seven-case synthetic regression and 219 tests passed. Completion attests the harness and negative evidence only; no comparator promotion or clinical, legal, policy, regulatory, employment, cultural-safety, organisational, deployment, operational or publication validation is claimed.

Hosted integration exposed 77.8 percent repository coverage and 61.40 percent patch coverage despite all functional tests passing. Substantive tests were added without lowering or excluding either gate. The local cross-platform-equivalent suite now passes 250 tests at 88.44 percent repository coverage; hosted exact-head checks remain the authority for final patch coverage and merge eligibility.
